record.hypothesis: Across Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl, change only the pairwise loss to margin-BPR: softplus(0.5-(positive_score-negative_score)). Retain the existing 0.8 pairwise/0.2 pointwise mixture and batch-wide valid-position averaging. A modest positive margin may maintain ranking pressure on moderately separated pairs and improve HR@10. Preserve HSTU topology, features, scoring, sampling, optimizer and training settings, with one independent model/checkpoint per category.
